title: India Inc’s earnings grew over 17% since 2019 but why stocks delivered less than 11% return
summary: Since 2019, India's earnings per share have grown at a remarkable rate of approximately 17.5%, far exceeding the stock returns of just 10.7% from the Nifty index during the same time frame. This discrepancy highlights valuation contraction while profit growth remains robust. As promoter share sales approach record levels, future market performance hinges on broad earnings growth and effective cash flow generation.

title: Strong disbursals take HFCs’ operating profit to 13-quarter high
summary: Housing finance companies saw a significant sequential operating profit growth in the September quarter, reaching a 13-quarter high. Disbursements surged by 10-59% due to increased demand for home loans across various markets. Despite a rise in interest expenses, profitability improved, leading to nearly 6% growth in net profit. Four companies reported better asset quality, while PNB Housing Finance led in disbursement growth.

title: CBDT reviews stakeholder inputs on LTCG, STT tax
summary: Central Board of Direct Taxes chairman Ravi Agrawal mentioned that the government is reviewing stakeholder suggestions about LTCG and STT. He assured that all viewpoints will be considered before making a decision. The deadline for any potential announcements is set for February 1. The board remains optimistic about meeting the direct tax collection target for 2026-27.

title: NSE joins Rs 5 lakh crore m-cap club, overtakes LIC in valuation
summary: National Stock Exchange of India achieved a market capitalisation of ₹5 lakh crore for the first time recently. The stock closed at a record high of ₹2,070.05 on the BSE, up 4.02%. NSE surpassed Life Insurance Corporation of India in market value, now ranked as India's 10th most valued listed company. NSE shares gained significantly despite broader market movements, demonstrating strong investor interest.

title: Urban Company unveils QIP to raise Rs 2,500 crore
summary: Urban Company has announced its intention to raise ₹2,500 crore through a qualified institutional placement. The company plans to invest ₹600 crore towards its InstaHelp business, focusing on rapid househelp services. Additionally, Urban Company will allocate funds for marketing initiatives and technology development. Some analysts remain cautious about the profitability of the instant help vertical. Urban Company's ongoing investments aim to solidify its market position amid competition.

title: BSE's BANKEX futures get CFTC nod to enter US market
summary: In a significant development, the BSE has gained approval from the US Commodity Futures Trading Commission for its BANKEX index futures contract, paving the way for American institutional investors to trade this innovative offering. The contract represents top banking stocks on the BSE, enhancing investment avenues in the banking sector.

title: Morgan Stanley expects Sensex to hit 95,000 in 2027
summary: Morgan Stanley anticipates Indian equities will regain momentum by 2027, projecting the Sensex to rise significantly. The brokerage estimates the Sensex could reach 95,000 by December 2027, driven by several factors. Factors contributing to this rise include the improving earnings cycle and attractive valuations. Morgan Stanley favors domestic cyclicals and is overweight on consumer discretionary and industrials sectors.

title: D-Street extends winning streak on FPI inflows, easing crude prices
summary: Indian equity indices saw gains supported by foreign fund inflows and stable crude prices on Monday. The BSE Sensex increased by 512.34 points, while the NSE Nifty rose by 146.80 points. Foreign Portfolio Investors were significant buyers, contributing ₹4,864 crore on the same day. However, domestic institutional investors sold equities worth ₹3,519 crore during the trading session. The broader market struggled, showing declines in midcap and smallcap indices.

title: Bank Nifty hits fresh record high, gains 14% since October 27
summary: The Nifty Bank index achieved a new closing high of 61,575.90, reflecting a 0.9% increase. This surge was aided by the decline in crude oil prices and increased foreign investment in banking stocks. The index has seen a significant rally over the last three weeks, surpassing previous records. HDFC Bank led the gains with a notable increase, followed by other major banks.

title: Stocks in news: Adani Enterprises, BSE, Senco Gold, Hero Motors, HDFC Life, Anand Rathi Wealth and Urban Company
summary: Indian equity markets witnessed a recovery on Monday, with modest gains recorded as the Nifty 50 index rose by 147 points, signaling renewed investor enthusiasm for large-cap stocks. In contrast, midcap and smallcap shares faced significant selling, creating a negative market breadth. Important announcements from Adani Enterprises and HDFC Life Insurance spurred interest among investors. A further upward trajectory may be possible after some minor price range consolidation.

title: D-St set for a cautious opening as GIFT Nifty signals muted start
summary: Indian equity markets witnessed a modest rise, recovering some ground lost in recent sessions. Analysts noted a selective investor participation, indicating underlying market weakness. Heavyweight stocks contributed significantly to lifting benchmark indices, although caution is advised. Foreign portfolio investors made notable net purchases, while domestic institutions engaged in selling. The rupee gained against the US dollar due to foreign inflows and improving market conditions.

title: Defeating Volatility: Market wealth at 10-month peak on peppy sentiment
summary: India's global market capitalisation has seen a remarkable upswing since October, adding about $500 billion and reaching close to $5.42 trillion. This rebound has enabled India to reclaim its fifth-place ranking in the world. The return of foreign investors, after a substantial sell-off in AI stocks, is a testament to India's recovery against the backdrop of ongoing economic and market turbulence.

title: Stock Radar: Falling fuel costs could lift IndiGo stock further; Shivangi Sarada recommends buying the stock
summary: IndiGo's stock has shown signs of recovery after testing lower levels in October. Experts suggest buying the stock, anticipating a rise towards the 52-week high of Rs 5950. Strong upward momentum and supportive moving averages indicate a favorable trading environment. A key resistance level has emerged at Rs 5500 for traders to consider. Overall, the stock is reflecting positive trends influenced by falling crude oil prices.

title: Clean energy companies bat for duty cuts, export relief
summary: The green energy industry is seeking customs duty concessions on manufacturing inputs and easing export obligations. Key inputs such as polysilicon and wafers do not have adequate local availability. The industry also requests an extension of duty exemptions for capital goods related to lithium-ion cells. Additionally, they propose changes in tax classifications that affect battery energy storage systems and taxation on interest payments.

title: Insurance cover for robotic surgeries may expand as GIC reviews list
summary: The General Insurance Council is focusing on expanding coverage for robotic-assisted surgeries for various conditions. It plans to periodically review recommendations based on emerging clinical evidence and technological advancements. A panel of medical specialists will aid in making informed insurance decisions across different specialties. Robotic procedures like prostatectomy and nephrectomy may receive reimbursement based on their complexity. The final position statement remains flexible and subject to future consultations with experts.

title: As industry steps up activity, corporate borrowing follows
summary: Corporate loan demand is increasing as companies in various sectors seek financing to support growth. The Reserve Bank of India's survey shows significant improvements in manufacturing capacity utilisation and order books. Public sector banks reported an increase in corporate lending pipelines, reflecting emerging investment trends. Investment is expanding across traditional and newer sectors, such as renewable energy and data centres.

title: Indian Steel Association calls EU's anti-dumping duty assessment 'unfair'
summary: The Indian Steel Association has criticised the European Commission’s decision to impose anti-dumping duties on cold-rolled steel imports, calling its assessment of Indian production costs unfair. The EU has imposed a 9.5% duty on India, while rates for other countries range from 3% to 27.9%.

title: NARCL gets 400 cr in resolution of Essel Group road co, beats estimate
summary: NARCL has successfully resolved the account of Ludhiana Talwandi Toll Roads, exceeding the expected recovery amount. The joint venture includes Agrawal Infrabuild and Silica Infra, which will share equal stakes. The resolution plan was approved by the NCLT and completed in about 18 months, with the total recovery surpassing ₹400 crore. The toll road project faced operational delays and disruptions due to farmer protests.

title: RBI files review plea in Supreme Court in YES Bank’s Rs 8415 crore AT1 bond write off case
summary: The RBI has filed a review petition in the Supreme Court challenging its October 15 ruling that quashed YES Bank's Rs 8,415 crore AT1 bond write-off during its 2020 restructuring. The move follows YES Bank's own review plea last week, after the court questioned the regulator's role in the controversial exercise.

title: Dollar Erases Liberation Day Loss as ‘Sell America’ Fear Fades
summary: The dollar has recovered all of its decline since President Donald Trump announced tariffs on so-called Liberation Day. A resilient economy, rising interest rates and the artificial intelligence boom have boosted the US currency’s appeal.

summary: After a debt-free demerger, Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles is back in debt, burning cash, and facing mounting pressure on profitability, largely due to its British subsidiary Jaguar Land Rover.
